messages:
maria: Quick Q — planning GCP KMS for a Private deployment. Control-plane SA needs to wrap/unwrap per-tenant DEKs stored in the app DB. Want least-privilege + auditability. What exact IAM bindings should we assign and any gotchas for cross-project keyrings?

alex: Short answer: grant the control-plane SA roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the specific cryptoKey (or on the keyRing if you want to cover multiple keys). That gives encrypt/decrypt (wrap/unwarp).

maria: Do we need roles/cloudkms.admin anywhere for rotation ops?

alex: Not for normal runtime wrap/unwrap. Admin is only for key lifecycle ops (create keys, set IAM, manage protections). For rotation, KMS can auto-rotate versions. But if you run a rewrap job to re-encrypt existing wrapped DEKs to a new key version, the worker needs decrypt on the old key and encrypt on the new version (so encrypter/decrypter covers both).

irfan: One big gotcha: Cloud Audit Logs DATA_ACCESS for KMS (encrypt/decrypt) is not enabled by default at org/project level. If you want to see who called Encrypt/Decrypt, enable DATA_ACCESS logs for Cloud KMS in the org logging config. Otherwise you won't get useful evidence for rewraps.

jen: If the control-plane SA in our infra project impersonates a customer SA in the customer project, remember to give the impersonator SA roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on the target customer SA, and then grant the target SA the cloudkms roles on the key resource. That avoids granting cross-project KMS roles to the infra SA directly.

alex: Also think about protection level: SOFTWARE vs HSM. IAM is the same role set, but HSM keys have higher cost/quotas and compliance implications. If customers request HSM, use protection-level=HSM when creating the key.

maria: Any region/location gotchas for a central keyring strategy? Customer is proposing a central key ring in the org project.

irfan: Keys are regional (or multi-regional). Choose a location that satisfies data residency. Cross-region calls work but may add latency/egress. Central key ring is ok but ensure networking and egress controls are acceptable and the key's location aligns with compliance.

jen: Example gcloud snippets for the binding (simplified):
```
# grant encrypt/decrypt on a key
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding my-key \ 
  --location=us-central1 --keyring=my-kr \
  --member=serviceAccount:control-plane@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

irfan: To enable DATA_ACCESS logs for Cloud KMS: go to IAM & Admin -> Audit Logs in the GCP Console and enable Data Access for Cloud KMS (or configure via org policy / logging sinks). Then sink those logs to BigQuery or Pub/Sub for your SIEM.

maria: Rotation and rewrap: customer wants nightly rotation + rewrap window. Any recommended pattern?

alex: We run a rewrap worker that: 1) lists DB entries with wrapped DEKs, 2) decrypts with the currently valid key version, 3) encrypts with the newly active key version, 4) writes back. During the rollover window the worker needs decrypt permission on both old and new keys (or the key with both versions). Schedule should tolerate backoff if KMS rate limits.

irfan: Important: keep the old key version enabled until rewraps complete. If you disable/delete old version early you'll lose ability to decrypt old wrappers. Also log the keyVersion used for each wrap/unwrap in the DB metadata so rewrap can choose proper decrypt key.

jen: Ops checklist for onboarding a customer key: 1) create keyRing in approved project/location, 2) create cryptoKey with desired protectionLevel and rotation schedule, 3) add IAM binding for the runtime SA (encrypter/decrypter), 4) enable DATA_ACCESS audit logs and verify sinks, 5) provide runbook for rewrap and rotation rollback.

maria: Nice. One more: do we prefer resource-level binding (key) vs keyRing-level?

\alex: Key-level is least-privilege. KeyRing-level is convenient when multiple keys share same consumers. Use resource-level when onboarding sensitive customers.
\deploy-bot: deploy finished: rewrap-worker v2 -> prod :rocket:

maria: Thanks folks — I'll draft an IAM playbook + rewrap runbook and ping @eng-security for review. :thumbsup:
